source: Out-of-domain CQs on ORKG templates without template-specific guidance. Questions and gold SPARQL drafted with an AI assistant from live data inspection (15 Nov 2026); to be checked by a human author.

items.question: Which psychological constructs are investigated, and which ones are studied in the most papers?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?construct_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C115015 ; orkgp:P175094 ?x . ?x rdfs:label ?construct_label . }

items.question: How is impulsivity measured across studies?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?measure_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C115015 ; orkgp:P175094 ?x ; orkgp:P175095 ?m . ?x rdfs:label ?xl . ?m rdfs:label ?measure_label . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?xl)) = "impulsivity") }

items.question: How many distinct constructs does each paper study?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper (COUNT(DISTINCT ?x) AS ?n_constructs) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C115015 ; orkgp:P175094 ?x . } GROUP BY ?paper

items.question: Which research approaches (for example observational or experimental) do ecology and evolution studies use?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?approach_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C65000 ; orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?a . ?a rdfs:label ?approach_label . }

items.question: On which continents are ecology and evolution studies conducted, and how many studies are there per continent?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?continent_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C65000 ; <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/wikidata:P30> ?k . ?k rdfs:label ?continent_label . }

items.question: Which taxonomic groups are studied in studies that follow an observational approach?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?taxon_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C65000 ; orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?a ; orkgp:P39141 ?t . ?a rdfs:label ?al . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?al)) = "observational approach") OPTIONAL { ?t rdfs:label ?tl } BIND(COALESCE(?tl, ?t) AS ?taxon_label) }

items.question: At which ecological organizational scale (individual, population, community, ecosystem, ...) do the studies operate?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?scale_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C65000 ; orkgp:P115002 ?s . ?s rdfs:label ?scale_label . }

items.question: How many years does each ecology and evolution study last?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?duration WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C65000 ; orkgp:P15594 ?d . OPTIONAL { ?d rdfs:label ?dl } BIND(COALESCE(?dl, ?d) AS ?duration) }

items.question: In which countries are the described ecological study systems located?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?country_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c orkgp:P115000 ?s . ?s a orkgc:C65002 ; orkgp:P37524 ?k . ?k rdfs:label ?country_label . }

items.question: Which habitats do the described ecological study systems cover?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?habitat_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c orkgp:P115000 ?s . ?s a orkgc:C65002 ; <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/wikidata:P2974> ?h . OPTIONAL { ?h rdfs:label ?hl } BIND(COALESCE(?hl, ?h) AS ?habitat_label) }

items.question: Which nutritional and metabolic diseases are studied most often?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?disease_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P134011 ?d . ?d rdfs:label ?disease_label . }

items.question: In which geographical areas are studies on obesity conducted?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?area_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P134011 ?d ; orkgp:P135009 ?a . ?d rdfs:label ?dl . ?a rdfs:label ?area_label . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dl)) = "obesity") }

items.question: How long do the dietary interventions last (value and unit)?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?duration_value ?duration_unit WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P187010 ?q . ?q orkgp:P45075 ?duration_value . OPTIONAL { ?q orkgp:P45076 ?u . ?u rdfs:label ?duration_unit } }

items.question: Which types of diet are investigated in studies on type 2 diabetes?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?diet_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P134011 ?d ; orkgp:P191006 ?t . ?d rdfs:label ?dl . ?t rdfs:label ?diet_label . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dl)) = "type 2 diabetes") }

items.question: Which biomarkers are measured in nutritional and metabolic disease studies?
goldQueries: SELECT ?paper ?biomarker_label WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C123091 ; orkgp:P192000 ?b . ?b rdfs:label ?biomarker_label . }
